$comment: Circle AI BugHunter VRT taxonomy. Referenced by .github/workflows/bughunter-gate.yml and CircleAI.Security scanning gates.

categories.name: Injection
categories.description: SQL, command, or code injection via unsanitised input

categories.name: Broken Authentication
categories.description: Hardcoded credentials or missing authentication checks

categories.name: Sensitive Data Exposure
categories.description: Credentials or PII written to logs or console

categories.name: Insecure Deserialization
categories.description: Use of unsafe deserializers that allow arbitrary type instantiation

categories.name: Security Misconfiguration
categories.description: Insecure default configuration or overly permissive CORS/HTTPS settings

categories.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
categories.description: Unescaped user input rendered as HTML markup

categories.name: Unhandled Exception Leak
categories.description: Raw exception details returned to caller or logged externally

categories.name: Using Components with Known Vulnerabilities
categories.description: Detected via dotnet list package --vulnerable; no source pattern
